notes: Farringdon’s two glazed canopy families, Cowcross heritage entrance and modern mainline hall, low western ticket hall and Bloom offices, and the complete Kaleidoscope eastern host including its Long Lane corner wing. The short thresholds, aprons and lobby recesses approximate current street grades using the standard host terrain and PMTiles pavement. Canopy profiles and underground rail levels are visual estimates. The western low ticket hall roof and Bloom height are inferred from current street and aerial photographs. The model shows the above-ground building envelopes and recessed doors. Platform interiors, escalators, train service and street furnishings use the host scene.
